# Waypoints

<!-- docs:begin summary -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs. Edit src/info.ts, then run `pnpm readme`. -->

Waypoints lets you create shared locations, control who can access each one, show them on a Java HUD, and look them up with PumpkinPIE placeholders.
<!-- docs:end summary -->

<!-- docs:begin reference -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs from package, action, extension, and component docs metadata. Run `pnpm readme`. -->

See the [plugin guide](https://filiphsps.github.io/pumpkin-plugins/packages/waypoints/docs/) and [API reference](https://filiphsps.github.io/pumpkin-plugins/api/plugins/waypoints/) on the documentation site.
<!-- docs:end reference -->

## Overview

Waypoints stores shared named locations on the server. Each waypoint can have a display label,
description, color, item icon, and optional HUD visibility range. Waypoints are restricted by default;
operators can make them public or grant access to specific players, permission nodes, or
permission-marker groups. Players can find and teleport to enabled waypoints they can access. Records
have no creator ownership.

## Installation

<!-- docs:begin installation -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs. Edit src/info.ts, then run `pnpm readme`. -->

Download `waypoints.wasm` from the plugin's GitHub release, put it in your server's `plugins/` folder, and restart Pumpkin. On the first load, a full restart lets Pumpkin ask for the plugin's permissions; hot reload cannot prompt for them.
<!-- docs:end installation -->

## Permissions

<!-- docs:begin permissions -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs. Edit src/info.ts, then run `pnpm readme`. -->

Pumpkin asks you to approve these on the server console when it loads the plugin. It skips the question when the `[plugins]` table in `pumpkin.toml` lists all of them in `allowed_permissions` or sets `ask_permission_confirmation = false`. Pumpkin remembers your answer and asks again after the plugin file or this list changes.

| Permission | Why |
| --- | --- |
| `fs.read.data` | Read the waypoint store from the plugin data folder. |
| `fs.write.data` | Persist waypoint changes in the plugin data folder. |
| `http.outbound` | Check Pumpkin Market for plugin updates. |
<!-- docs:end permissions -->

## Commands

<!-- docs:begin commands -->
<!-- Generated by pumpkin-plugins-docs. Edit src/info.ts, then run `pnpm readme`. -->

| Command | Description | Permission | Default access |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `/wp create` | Create a waypoint at your position or explicit coordinates | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp create <name>` | Create a waypoint at your position or explicit coordinates | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp create <name> <x> <y> <z>` | Create a waypoint at your position or explicit coordinates | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp reload` | Reload waypoint data from disk | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp delete <name>` | Delete a waypoint by name | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp rename <name> <newName>` | Rename a waypoint | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp relocate` | Move a waypoint to your position or explicit coordinates | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp relocate <name>` | Move a waypoint to your position or explicit coordinates | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp relocate <name> <x> <y> <z>` | Move a waypoint to your position or explicit coordinates | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp list` | List enabled waypoints you can access | `Waypoints:command.use` | everyone |
| `/wp info <name>` | Show details for an enabled waypoint you can access | `Waypoints:command.use` | everyone |
| `/wp teleport` | Teleport to a waypoint or, as an admin, teleport selected players | `Waypoints:command.use` | everyone |
| `/wp teleport <name>` | Teleport to a waypoint or, as an admin, teleport selected players | `Waypoints:command.use` | everyone |
| `/wp teleport <name> <targets>` | Teleport to a waypoint or, as an admin, teleport selected players | `Waypoints:command.use` | everyone |
| `/wp tp` | Alias for teleport | `Waypoints:command.use` | everyone |
| `/wp tp <name>` | Alias for teleport | `Waypoints:command.use` | everyone |
| `/wp tp <name> <targets>` | Alias for teleport | `Waypoints:command.use` | everyone |
| `/wp enable <name>` | Enable a waypoint | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp disable <name>` | Disable a waypoint | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp get <name>` | Inspect a waypoint, including disabled records | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp access public <name>` | Allow every player to access a waypoint | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp access restricted <name>` | Restrict a waypoint to its grants | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp access list <name>` | List a waypoint access mode and its grants | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp access grant player <name> <player>` | Grant access to an online player | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp access grant permission <name> <permission>` | Grant access to a permission node | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp access grant group <name> <group>` | Grant access to a permission marker group | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp access revoke player <name> <player>` | Revoke a player grant by online name or UUID | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp access revoke permission <name> <permission>` | Revoke a permission node grant | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp access revoke group <name> <group>` | Revoke a permission marker group grant | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp set color <name> <hex>` | Set the waypoint color | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp set icon <name> <item>` | Set the waypoint item icon | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp set label <name> <label>` | Set the waypoint display label | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp set description <name> <description>` | Set the waypoint description | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp set visibility-range <name> <range>` | Set the waypoint rendering range in blocks | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
| `/wp reset <property> <name>` | Reset a label, description, color, icon, or visibility range | `Waypoints:command.admin` | operators (level 3) |
<!-- docs:end commands -->
